verdict.rationale: Jira documents one-way flows from code tools: automation with Bitbucket "keeps Jira up to date" and development status is viewable inside Jira. Its docs also point to 3000+ Marketplace integrations and rich APIs, which could support a self-built or third-party sync. Nothing shows native two-way syncing of tasks with a repository's own issue tracker; the only 'syncing' claim is for Trello, which is not a code-repo tracker. Missing for 10: documented bi-directional sync with a repo issue tracker (e.g. GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket issues), field/status mapping details, conflict handling, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
